rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying you love or like someone very deeply.

example.english: I adore my daughter and always want to spend time with her.
example.traditional: 我好鍾意我個女，成日都想陪住佢。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 ngo5 go3 neoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 soeng2 pui4 zyu6 keoi5

rows.note: Use this when the deep affection involves dote-like tenderness, especially toward a child or close family member.

example.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 tang4 oi3 go3 neoi5

rows.note: Use this in formal or respectful contexts when the affection includes strong admiration and respect.

example.english: The teachers and students at the school all adore the principal.
example.jyutping: cyun4 haau6 si1 sang1 dou1 ging3 oi3 haau6 zoeng2

rows.note: Use this for religious worship, or for adoring someone as an idol or hero rather than expressing intimate affection.

example.english: I adore this firefighter; they have saved many people.
example.traditional: 我好崇拜呢位消防員，佢救過好多人。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 sung4 baai3 ni1 wai2 siu1 fong4 jyun4 keoi5 gau3 gwo3 hou2 do1 jan4
